dashboard.title: My Projects
dashboard.noProjectsHint: Create your first floor plan project and get 5 NBC-compliant layout variations in seconds.
dashboard.onboardingStep1: Enter your plot dimensions and room preferences
dashboard.onboardingStep3: Export standard or approval-ready PDF, DXF, and BOQ

project.newProjectHint: Enter your plot details to generate NBC-compliant floor plan options.
project.cityHint: Applies city-specific setback tables and FAR limits.
project.municipalityHint: Applies bye-law specific ground coverage, FAR, and height limits.
project.stiltWarning: Stilt floor only allows parking, lift lobby, pump room, and electric room — no habitable spaces.
project.basementNote: Basement allows parking, gym, store room, and utility. Mechanical ventilation required (no natural light).
project.g2Warning: G+2 buildings require a structural engineer's review. PlanForge will generate layouts but cannot certify structural adequacy.
project.bhkWarning: 4BHK requires minimum 200 sqm (≈ 2,150 sq ft) plot area
project.attachedToiletsDesc: Adds an en-suite toilet to each bedroom automatically. The toilets count above then means COMMON toilets only.
project.noRoomsAdded: No rooms added. Click "Add room" to start.
project.vastuDesc: Check room placement against Vastu Shastra principles
project.vastuEnabled: Vastu analysis checks room zones against Vastu Shastra principles (NE sacred zone, SE kitchen, SW master bedroom, etc.) and flags violations in layout compliance.
project.quadHint: Enter 4 corner coordinates in metres (CCW: Front-Left → Front-Right → Rear-Right → Rear-Left). Front-Left is fixed at (0, 0).
project.setbackHelp: The minimum distance a structure must maintain from the plot boundary — required by local building rules.
project.stiltHelp: A stilt floor leaves the ground floor open for parking; living spaces start from the floor above.
project.municipalityHelp: The local authority (e.g. CMDA, BBMP, GHMC) whose building code and setback/FAR rules apply to your plot.
project.quadUnitsHelp: Quadrilateral corners are entered directly in metres — every other measurement on this form uses feet.
project.templateLoadFailed: Couldn't load the template — starting with a blank form instead.

hints.chatBody: Ask for changes in plain English — "make the master bedroom larger" — and see them applied to the layout.
hints.overlaysBody: Toggle furniture, electrical, and plumbing overlays on top of the floor plan.
hints.compareBody: Line up two generated layouts to see how they differ before you choose one.
hints.historyBody: Save a snapshot before a big edit, or roll back to an earlier version any time.
